title: Go Concurrency & Patterns

entries.label: Context with Timeout
entries.command:
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Second)
defer cancel()
result, err := doWork(ctx)
entries.description: Set a deadline for an operation — always defer cancel
